action.entry: first observable 1m open strictly after completed-hour decision +500ms
action.state_loss: first later completed-hour close back inside exact consumed boundary, executed after +500ms
action.stop: opposite of consumed boundary and breakout-hour excursion, whichever is more conservative

event_deduplication: If one completed hour consumes multiple nested scales, emit one parent labeled by the largest consumed scale.
logic: High-participation close beyond a pre-existing external range tests new-price acceptance. One pooled full-realization Core must preserve the same meaning across 24/48/96/192-hour ranges and BTC/ETH long/short testbeds.
pre_outcome_corrections: state-loss execution minute cannot reuse later minute high/low
adverse/favorable state-exit gaps use stop-open/target cap

sponsorship.feature: completed-hour log1p(volume) z-score over inherited 168-hour calculation
sponsorship.provenance: inherited 2021 upper-quartile threshold from retained accepted-delivery family
